head.title: Business grants in Madeira 2026 — verified guides | SeedWave
head.description: Which public support programmes are open to businesses in Madeira in 2026, for whom, how much and how to apply. Every figure links to its primary source.
head.ogTitle: Business grants in Madeira — what is open right now
head.ogDescription: Deadlines, rates and conditions of Madeira's support programmes, with no small print. Every figure comes from the official call.

hero.h1: Public money moves through Madeira. Most businesses never come to claim it.
hero.lead: Not because they don't qualify — because nobody told them in time. Here is what is open, how much it pays, until when, and what you need in hand. Every figure links to the official source.

odo.label: Public contracts signed in Madeira in 2026
odo.sub: {n} contracts · open data from IMPIC (Portal BASE) via dados.gov.pt. That is contract spending — business support programmes are a separate pot, and that one you apply for.

acts.shareText: Business grants in Madeira, explained with the official sources:

news.note: Only entries backed by a published call or decree. Announcements without official text stay out.

guides.note: Each guide in five languages, each language on its own address.

items.title: Grants for cafés and restaurants in Madeira 2026
items.blurb: Which programmes exist (SIEED, digitalisation, start-up, hiring), how much they pay and how to apply.

items.title: SIEED — applications until 10 October 2026
items.blurb: Energy Efficiency 2030 (call M2030-2026-21): 50% for SMEs, what it covers in a café or restaurant, and how to apply before the deadline.

items.title: Digitalising a café in Madeira 2026 — is there an open call?
items.blurb: The honest answer: today there is no open call for digitalisation alone. What closed, and what to prepare now for the next window.

group.h3: WhatsApp channel for calls and deadlines
group.p: A call opens, a deadline moves, a new rate is published — it arrives here in one line. A channel, not a group: your phone stays quiet.

bridge: These guides are written so you can do it yourself — that is what they are for. If you would rather someone ran the application end to end, see who I am and how I work.
